column2: #You will also use this page to describe your overall experimental design. Each should be written in paragraph form and can be up to 300 words max. If appropriate, it should cover each of the following issues: randomization, controls (positive and/or negative), blinding. Make sure that this description matches the data you will be analyzing, not a bigger experiment with more variables that you will not have data for.
#Explanatory and Response Variables - explicitly and simply state your explanatory/independent/x variable and your response/dependent/y variable.
#Sample size - include a description of your sample size and a justification for your choice.
